visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Choosing the Right Input Type
visualizerParams.description: Type three inputs with the right type: number, email and date. The type gives phones the right keyboard and lets the browser reject wrong values.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
<form>
  <input id="age" type="number" min="1" max="120">
  <input id="mail" type="email">
  <input id="born" type="date">
</form>
